name: diary-study-designer
description: Designs diary studies for behavior that interviews can't reach, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run diary-study-designer", "set up a diary study", "we need to see behavior over time", "how do people use this across a week", or the research question involves habits, moods, or moments no one can recall accurately afterward. Use it even for "we wish we could see what they do between sessions".
